BEP 55: Holepunch Extension.

Enables NAT traversal via a relay peer. The initiating peer sends a rendezvous message to a relay, which forwards connect messages to both sides, prompting simultaneous uTP connection attempts.

Remove all hole-punch state for the target endpoint.

utils

Types

  msgType*: uint8
  addrType*: uint8
  ip*: string                ## Dotted-quad IPv4 or colon-hex IPv6
  port*: uint16
  errCode*: uint32
HolepunchState = object
  attempts*: int
  successes*: int
  lastError*: string
